plugins.contactsPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your contacts so you can add the ones you choose to your business CRM. Only contacts you explicitly select are saved.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your photos and videos so you can upload them to your Google Business Profile.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use the camera so you can take photos and record videos for your Google Business Profile.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use the microphone so videos you record for your Google Business Profile include sound.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use your location when you take a photo or record a video in the app, so it records where it was taken.
